name: Off-Highway Vehicle
description: A snow vehicle, all-terrain vehicle, motorcycle, mini bike, four-wheel-drive or low-tire-pressure vehicle or dune buggy that isn't registered for the road; an electric dirt bike like a Sur-Ron or Talaria ridden off-road is one.

restrictions.rule: Not a vehicle registered for road use; no limit on motor power or speed
restrictions.citation: Off-highway Vehicles Act, R.S.N.S. 1989, c. 323, s. 2(d)

restrictions.rule: Needs an off-highway vehicle permit from the Registrar, with the owner's identification number displayed on it
restrictions.citation: Off-highway Vehicles Act, R.S.N.S. 1989, c. 323, ss. 3 and 4

restrictions.rule: The operator and any passenger must wear a helmet meeting the regulations' standards
restrictions.citation: Off-highway Vehicles Act, R.S.N.S. 1989, c. 323, s. 10; Off-highway Vehicles General Regulations, N.S. Reg. 13/1988, s. 11

restrictions.rule: Operators must be 16 or older and certified in off-highway vehicle safety training; 14- and 15-year-olds may ride within sight of a parent or guardian, both certified
restrictions.citation: Off-highway Vehicles Act, R.S.N.S. 1989, c. 323, ss. 11 and 11A

restrictions.rule: Under 14 only on private property, supervised and trained, on a machine sized for the rider
restrictions.citation: Off-highway Vehicles Act, R.S.N.S. 1989, c. 323, s. 11(3)

restrictions.rule: Must carry third-party liability insurance on land the rider doesn't own or occupy
restrictions.citation: Off-highway Vehicles Act, R.S.N.S. 1989, c. 323, s. 15B

restrictions.rule: Kept off a highway, its shoulder and median, except to load or unload, cross at right angles, ride the ditch, use an unplowed snowbound road outside towns, or where the Road Trails Act or the Minister allows; riding on the travelled portion needs a driver's licence
restrictions.citation: Off-highway Vehicles Act, R.S.N.S. 1989, c. 323, s. 12

restrictions.rule: Not allowed in wetlands, watercourses, sand dunes, coastal or highland barrens or designated sensitive areas
restrictions.citation: Off-highway Vehicles Act, R.S.N.S. 1989, c. 323, s. 12A
